evaluation_reservation.policy: Final policy after Sunday 06:00 PT freeze; never Saturday v1 walk policy

selection: Metadata only: walking street scenes in three European cities, CC BY 3.0, original dimensions 1920x1080 and duration >=7s; fixed 2.000–7.000s before pixel decode. No substitutions. No claim of native capture resolution or visible text. London and Liverpool share POPtravel author.
seed_recipe: big-endian uint32 of first four SHA256 bytes of UTF8(fresh-heldout-v2: + clip ID)
recipe: NVENC p4 10M yuv420p; 1280x720 crop/scale, CFR30 start_time=0 with a 150-frame cap; no audio/source metadata; bench.synthetic.overlay with tune camera tracking
natural_truth: 150 empty arrays of synthetic truth only; no natural OCR truth generated during preparation
